displayName.zh: 拉普兰地区旅行准备度

title.zh: 芬兰国家公园与徒步指南

summary.en: During 'Kaamos' (Polar Night, Dec-Jan), the sun does not rise. Continuous darkness can cause fatigue and disorientation.
summary.zh: 在"极夜"（Kaamos，12月-1月）期间，太阳不会升起。持续的黑暗可能导致疲劳和方向感迷失。

mitigations.en: Stick to a regular sleep schedule despite the darkness.
mitigations.zh: 尽管天黑，也要保持规律的睡眠时间表。

mitigations.en: Take Vitamin D supplements and make use of the few hours of 'blue twilight' around noon.
mitigations.zh: 补充维生素 D，并利用中午前后几小时的"蓝色暮光"时间活动。

summary.en: Distances between towns (e.g., Levi to Inari) are long. Gas stations are sparse. EV range drops significantly in cold (-30% to -50%).
summary.zh: 城镇之间（例如从列维到伊纳里）距离很远。加油站稀少。电动汽车（EV）的续航里程在寒冷中显著下降（减少 30% 到 50%）。

mitigations.en: Fill up the tank whenever it drops below half.
mitigations.zh: 油箱少于一半时请立即加满。

mitigations.en: Carry an emergency kit in the car: warm blanket, shovel, chocolate/snacks, flashlights.
mitigations.zh: 在车内携带应急包：保暖毯、铲子、巧克力/零食、手电筒。

mitigations.en: If driving an EV, verify fast charger availability (ABC, K-Lataus) beforehand.
mitigations.zh: 如果驾驶电动汽车，请提前核实快速充电桩（ABC, K-Lataus）的可用性。

summary.en: Moose (Elk) collisions are less common than reindeer but often fatal due to the animal's massive size.
summary.zh: 驼鹿（Elk）碰撞事故比驯鹿少见，但由于体型巨大，往往是致命的。

mitigations.en: Scan roadsides constantly. Moose fences exist but don't cover all roads.
mitigations.zh: 不断观察路边。虽然有防驼鹿围栏，但并未覆盖所有道路。

mitigations.en: High beams are essential at night; dim them only when meeting traffic.
mitigations.zh: 夜间必须使用远光灯；仅在会车时调暗。

items.en: Physical driving license (digital versions often not accepted by police)
items.zh: 实体驾驶执照（警方通常不接受电子版）

items.en: Engine block heater cable (if parking overnight outdoors)
items.zh: 发动机缸体加热线（如果在户外过夜停车）

items.en: Offline maps (Google Maps Area Download) - deep wilderness has zero signal
items.zh: 离线地图（Google Maps 区域下载）- 荒野深处完全没有信号

items.en: Snow brush and ice scraper (mandatory to clear ALL windows before driving)
items.zh: 雪刷和除冰铲（法律规定驾驶前必须清理所有车窗）

items.en: Respect for Sámi culture: Do not buy cheap 'Four Winds Hat' copies.
items.zh: 尊重萨米文化：不要购买廉价的仿制"四风帽"。

items.en: Swimsuit (for public saunas/ice swimming, though nudity is okay in gender-segregated ones)
items.zh: 泳衣（用于公共桑拿/冰泳，尽管在性别分开的桑拿中裸体也是可以的）

items.en: Cash (rarely needed, cards work 99% of places, even remote)
items.zh: 现金（很少需要，99% 的地方甚至偏远地区都可以刷卡）

message.en: Sámi culture is living, not just a tourist attraction. Do not photograph Sámi people without permission. Avoid wearing fake Sámi costumes (sold in some souvenir shops) as it is considered offensive.
message.zh: 萨米文化是鲜活的，不仅仅是旅游景点。未经许可请勿拍摄萨米人。避免穿着假的萨米服饰（部分纪念品商店有售），这被认为是冒犯行为。

title.en: Look for the 'Sámi Duodji' label when buying handicrafts
title.zh: 购买手工艺品时请认准 'Sámi Duodji' 标签

message.en: Everyman's Right (Jokamiehenoikeus) allows you to hike and pick berries/mushrooms anywhere, provided you do not disturb residents or damage nature. Do not walk close to private houses.
message.zh: "每个人的权利"（Jokamiehenoikeus）允许你在任何地方徒步和采摘浆果/蘑菇，前提是不打扰居民或破坏自然。请勿靠近私人住宅行走。

title.zh: 阅读"每个人的权利"摘要

message.en: Headlights must be switched ON at all times when driving, day and night, summer and winter. This is mandatory by law.
message.zh: 驾驶时必须始终打开前大灯，无论白天黑夜、夏天冬天。这是法律强制要求的。

title.en: Check headlight settings on rental car
title.zh: 检查租赁车辆的大灯设置

message.en: Strong alcohol (>5.5%) is ONLY sold in state-monopoly 'Alko' stores. They close early (usually 18:00 or 21:00) and are CLOSED on Sundays. Supermarkets only sell beer/cider.
message.zh: 烈性酒（>5.5%）仅在国家垄断的 'Alko' 商店出售。它们关门较早（通常是 18:00 或 21:00），且周日休息。超市只卖啤酒/苹果酒。

title.en: Check Alko opening hours if planning drinks
title.zh: 如果计划喝酒，请查看 Alko 的营业时间
